narrative: 波普风格、儿童神话、一张活过来的海报：图形化的形状、依然立体的面部塑造，以及颜料本身的湿润高光。油画布风（Canvas）是画廊里的油画。
泼墨特效（Ink Riot）是悬浮在空气中的液体。丙烯画风则是玩具和海报的材质。
对于一幅年代油画肖像，它是错误的工具；如果颜色变得像水彩那样稀薄，也是错误的用法。丙烯颜料看起来应该像塑料涂料。
how: 平视高度，35mm到50mm焦段，固定机位。硬光或硬柔混合的影棚主光，让笔触的凸起接住湿润的高光。
要求厚重的丙烯质感、高饱和度、图形化的形状，以及依然立体的面部塑造。Prompt: Acrylic look on [Subject], thick plastic color, poster edges, paint that still looks wet.
when: 波普风格、活过来的海报、玩具神话。不要用在浸透式的水彩，或年代油画上。
vs: 油画布风是画廊里的油画，有笔刷痕迹和画布纹理。泼墨特效是空气中的液体。
丙烯画风是覆盖在主体上的厚重塑料色彩。漫画风（Comic）则加入了网点。
这里的破绽是笔触的凸起和糖果般的高饱和色彩。
examples_film: 《至尊神探》（Dick Tracy）的局部色彩和妆容像海报颜料一样覆盖在脸上。波普艺术风格的电影把颜料当作糖果来处理。
借鉴的是那种塑料感的色彩，而不是某一帧画面。
mistakes: 稀薄的水彩，或与油画布风的油画质感混在一起。破绽是色彩被浸透，没有笔触凸起。
修正方法：厚重的丙烯质感、海报般的边缘，以及湿润的塑料高光。

faq.q: 电影中的丙烯画风（Akrill）是什么？
faq.a: 一种丙烯材质的风格：厚重的塑料色彩、海报般的边缘，湿润的颜料覆盖在世界之上。颜料在这里是一种物件，而不是一层色彩渲染。

faq.q: 丙烯画风（Akrill）与油画布风（Canvas）的区别
faq.a: 油画布风是油画和画布纹理，属于画廊质感。丙烯画风是丙烯颜料的笔触凸起和海报般的高饱和色。如果看起来像糖果塑料，你就在丙烯画风里；如果你能看到画布织纹，你想要的是油画布风。

faq.q: 什么时候该用丙烯画风？
faq.a: 波普、玩具、活过来的海报。跳过年代油画和稀薄的水彩。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写丙烯画风的提示词？
faq.a: 先写硬质主光，然后要求笔触凸起和湿润高光。保持面部的立体塑造。

narrative: Pop, a kids' myth, a poster that came alive: graphic shapes, a face still modeled, wet highlights on the paint itself. Canvas is gallery oil.
Ink riot is airborne liquid. Akrill is toy and poster matter.
It is the wrong tool for a period oil portrait, and the wrong tool if the color went watercolor-thin. Acrylic should look like plastic paint.
how: Eye height, 35mm to 50mm, lock-off. Hard or hard-soft studio key so ridges catch a wet highlight.
Ask for thick acrylic, high chroma, graphic shapes, modeled face. Prompt: Acrylic look on [Subject], thick plastic color, poster edges, paint that still looks wet.
when: Pop, poster-come-alive, a toy myth. Do not use it for soaked-in watercolor or a period oil.
vs: Canvas is gallery oil, bristle and tooth. Ink Riot is liquid in air.
Akrill is thick plastic color sitting on the subject. Comic adds halftone.
Here the tell is ridges and candy chroma.
examples_film: Dick Tracy 's spot color and makeup sit on faces like poster pigment. Pop-art cinema treats paint as candy.
Borrow the plastic color, not a frame.
mistakes: Thin watercolor, or a mash with Canvas oil. The tell is soaked-in color and no ridges.
Fix it: thick acrylic, poster edges, wet plastic highlights.

faq.a: An acrylic-matter look: thick plastic color, poster edges, wet pigment sitting on the world. It is paint as object, not a wash.
Canvas is oil and tooth, gallery stock. Akrill is acrylic ridges and poster chroma. If it looks like candy plastic, you are on akrill. If you see canvas weave, you wanted canvas.
Pop, toys, posters that come alive. Skip period oil and thin watercolor.

faq.q: How do I prompt Akrill for AI image or video?
faq.a: Hard key, then: Acrylic look on [Subject], thick plastic color, poster edges, paint that still looks wet. Demand ridges and wet highlights. Keep the face modeled.
